messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
i bundled up in four layers, wrapped a scarf around my head walked over 1 bridge and through the woods to set up my installation.

output.original_text: i bundled up in four layers, wrapped a scarf around my head walked over 1 bridge and through the woods to set up my installation.
output.joy: I bundled up in four cozy layers, wrapped a vibrant scarf around my head, and joyfully walked over one bridge and through the woods to set up my installation!
output.sadness: I bundled up in four layers, wrapped a dull scarf around my head, and trudged over one bridge and through the woods to set up my installation, feeling so alone.
output.fear: I bundled up in four layers, nervously wrapped a scarf around my head, and cautiously walked over one bridge and through the dark woods to set up my installation, my heart racing.
output.anger: I bundled up in four layers, wrapped a scarf around my head, and stomped over that stupid bridge and through the woods to set up my installation, so frustrated by everything!
output.surprise: I bundled up in four layers, wrapped a colorful scarf around my head, and unexpectedly found myself walking over one bridge and through the woods to set up my installation!
output.disgust: I bundled up in four layers, wrapped a grimy scarf around my head, and begrudgingly walked over a bridge and through the woods to set up my installation, feeling utterly repulsed.
